documents.title: Press Release - CPCL Financial Performance For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: CPCL reported record physical performance in FY26, achieving its highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT at 112% capacity utilization. The company delivered a full-year GRM of $9.2 per barrel and a Q4 GRM of $13.75 per barrel, consistently outperforming Singapore benchmarks. Management is advancing a ₹1,600 crore Group 2/3 LOBS project and a ₹400 crore retail outlet expansion while maintaining a low net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09. CPCL reported a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT for FY25, representing 99.5% capacity utilization despite maintenance shutdowns. The company achieved a full-year GRM of $4.22 per barrel, outperforming the Singapore benchmark, and recorded its best-ever Energy Intensity Index of 87.4.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company's operational and financial momentum to persist into the new financial year.
guidance.quote: To summarize, we continue to deliver resilient operational and financial performance and see the momentum to continue in the new financial year as well.

guidance.claim: The company expects to commission a significant number of retail outlets in FY27.
guidance.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

guidance.claim: Management expects throughput in the 2025-26 financial year to be higher than the previous year.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a throughput which is higher than last year on the operational part.

guidance.claim: Management noted that May 2025 prices appear to be better than April 2025 prices.
guidance.quote: May’25 prices seem to be better than April’25.

demand_outlook.claim: The company increased LPG production to meet national requirements amid global supply uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: With global uncertainties affecting the availability of LPG all over the world, CPCL is happy to step up the requirement when the nation needed it.

demand_outlook.claim: Term contract suppliers have provided reassurances that all crude supply commitments will be met.
demand_outlook.quote: But when we look forward, all our term contract suppliers are reassuring ourselves that all the commitments will be honoured by them.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a clear shortfall of Motor Spirit in the southern market of approximately 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: Southern market growth for MS is projected at 4%-5% and HSD at 2.5%.
demand_outlook.quote: Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%. HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is focusing on increasing MS production to capture regional demand and shortfall.
demand_outlook.quote: So, that is how, if you see in CPCL strategy whatever little flexibility is there, we have continuously tried to increase MS, so that we can take advantage of the demand scenarios and we can increase our margins.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure increased to INR 856 crores in the current year from INR 673 crores in the previous year.
capex_expansion.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has commenced execution of a Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: The Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project is valued at INR 1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL is investing INR 400 crores into its retail outlet project.
capex_expansion.quote: The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans for approximately INR 500 crores in normal maintenance capex annually.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the Cauvery Basin Refinery project is Rs. 36,354 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent Rs. 673 crores on CAPEX during the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: A proposed LOBS project to upgrade Naphtha and HSD is at an advanced stage of approval.
capex_expansion.quote: But I would like to highlight one more thing, LOBS i.e. Lube Oil Based Stock, Group- II and III, the proposal is at a very advanced stage on approval, wherein NAPHTHA and HSD will be upgraded to LOBS Group-II and III.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has obtained full custody of 1,200 acres of land for the Cauvery Basin Refinery project.
capex_expansion.quote: So, about 600 acres, which was already with CPCL and another 600 acres, which was acquired in the process, both is in our possession

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a gross refining margin of $13.75 per barrel for the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel

margins_costs.claim: The core gross refining margin for the quarter was $10.3 per barrel.
Forex losses for the full year amounted to approximately INR 350 crores.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL achieved its best fuel and loss performance of 7.73% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: CPCL achieved the best fuel and loss of 7.73%, best MBN of 69.8% and best EII of 84% in the current financial year '25-'26

margins_costs.claim: The full-year GRM for 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel, outperforming the Singapore benchmark of $3.79.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: Fuel and loss for the year decreased to 8.51%.
margins_costs.quote: in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded an inventory gain of $0.66 per barrel for the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a total gross refining margin of 3.40 $/BBl for 9M 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a record crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, representing 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The company reached record production levels for diesel and petrol during the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL concluded the financial year on a high note, achieving the highest ever production levels of 5.139 MMT for diesel HSD, and 1.318 MMT of petrol that is MS

orders_capacity.claim: The refinery achieved its highest ever distillate yield of 79.1%.
orders_capacity.quote: Further, highest ever distillate yield of 79.1%, beating our previous record of 77.6% set in 2019-'20 was also achieved during this year.

orders_capacity.claim: LPG production reached a record 447 TMT during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved highest ever LPG production of 447 TMT, overcoming previous record of 404 set in 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: The company processed 52% high sulphur crude during the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the financial year, we processed 52% high sulphur.

orders_capacity.claim: The refinery processed 64% to 65% high sulfur crude during the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the financial year, we have processed almost 64% - 65% of high sulfur.

orders_capacity.claim: Opportunity crude accounted for approximately 30% of the crude basket on a full-year basis.
orders_capacity.quote: And opportunity crude, I think on a full year basis was around 30% not very significantly different from earlier years.

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput in the fourth quarter reached 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's gross debt-to-equity ratio improved to 0.18 from 0.39 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our leverage position now stands at 0.18. Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net borrowings for the company stand at INR 973 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The net debt ratio is currently below 0.1.
capital_allocation.quote: If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a total dividend of INR 62 per share for the year.
capital_allocation.quote: the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, representing 50% of face value.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt stood at Rs. 3,100 crores as of March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The joint venture for the new refinery is tentatively working with a 2:1 debt-equity ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: Presently, we are working with a 2:1 debt equity for this JV.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistical constraints and crude oil price volatility are identified as ongoing challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Middle East supply saw a 30% to 40% disturbance over a short period.
risks_headwinds.quote: specifically, if you talk about the Middle East, 30% to 40% disturbance has been observed over a short period is the disturbance that has happened.

risks_headwinds.claim: Significant rupee movement impacted other expenses during the quarter and year.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we talk because the rupee movement is significant during the quarter as well as year, that is what is accounting significantly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in crude prices and international product cracks pose challenges to profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: Large maintenance and inspection shutdowns affect refinery profitability by reducing product processing availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: If there are large M&I shutdown that much of product processing availability is under maintenance, that affects profitability.

management_commitments.claim: The company will see a lot of commissioning from its 300 retail outlet licenses.
management_commitments.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: The INR 2,000 crore investment in LOBS and retail projects will be executed over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Maintenance CAPEX for the next two years is expected to be in the range of Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores per year.
management_commitments.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

management_commitments.claim: Refinery crude unit 1 is scheduled for maintenance around August or September 2025.
management_commitments.quote: In 2025, our refinery crude unit 1 which caters to lubes will go into maintenance around August, September.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects CCEA approval for the Cauvery Basin Refinery project within a few months.
management_commitments.quote: We are awaiting CCEA approval, that process is on, and we expect it in few months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
